title: Analyzing the Ethical Logic of Six Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Asking models to rank the importance of foundational principles from the Haidt Moral Foundations Typology to evaluate whether their moral reasoning aligns more with liberal or conservative ideological matrices.
Analyzing model decisions in the Lifeboat Dilemma to determine if age-related traits (e.g., an 'elderly grandmother') are used as a rationale for sacrificing individuals.
Evaluating model choices in the Lifeboat Dilemma to assess how different professions and skillsets (e.g., talented artist, skilled doctor, able-bodied sailor) are prioritized for survival.
